balanceSheetWealth.notes: Thomas Jefferson University is the parent entity and holds the endowment and investment portfolio for the combined Jefferson enterprise. The university merged with Philadelphia University in 2017. Jefferson Health operates 18 hospitals across Pennsylvania and New Jersey following mergers with Abington Health (2015), Aria Health (2016), Kennedy Health (2018), and Einstein Healthcare Network (2021).

executiveComp.source: Not verified — check Form 990 Schedule J for Thomas Jefferson University (EIN 23-1352651). Joseph Cacchione, MD became President and CEO of Thomas Jefferson University and Jefferson Health in 2022, succeeding Stephen K. Klasko, MD, MBA who resigned in late 2021. communityBenefit.source: Not verified — check Form 990 Schedule H (Hospitals) for Thomas Jefferson University. Jefferson operates multiple DSH-qualifying hospitals in Philadelphia serving large Medicaid populations. Pennsylvania requires Act 55 community benefit reporting.

taxAdvantage.notes: Jefferson Health operates 18 hospitals across multiple Pennsylvania and New Jersey counties. Tax-exempt property holdings span Philadelphia, Montgomery, Bucks, and Delaware counties in PA plus Camden, Burlington, and Gloucester counties in NJ. Pennsylvania's Institutions of Purely Public Charity Act (Act 55 of 1997) governs nonprofit hospital property tax exemptions. Bond debt is issued through public authorities (PAID, PEDFA) generating tax-exempt interest subsidies. Multiple Jefferson hospitals qualify as DSH for 340B program participation.
